policy: All changes to published artefacts (@kannan19302/contracts, @kannan19302/auth, @kannan19302/shared, @kannan19302/framework) must be classified as BREAKING, DEPRECATED, or COMPATIBLE before landing. BREAKING changes require a target version, migration guide, and enumeration of affected consumers. DEPRECATED symbols require a deprecation date and removal-allowed-after date. Unclassified changes to protected packages fail CI.

classifications.BREAKING: The change removes, renames, or alters the observable contract of an exported symbol in a way that requires consumers to change their code.
classifications.DEPRECATED: The change marks a symbol as pending removal with a declared deprecation window. Consumers must migrate before the removal date.
classifications.COMPATIBLE: The change adds new symbols, fields, or capabilities without altering or removing existing ones. No consumer action required.
